concerns.text: FR-014 requires validating 'all data and output' against the contract schemas, and the data model's MMN Metric entity is per-subject (subject_id-bearing). T003 produces data/results/metrics_per_subject.csv as a primary output, but no task validates it: T006 tests only metrics.csv, stats.json, and dataset metadata. The per-subject tier has no schema and no contract test, leaving FR-014/data-model coverage partial. Add a task (or extend T006) to define and validate a per-subject schema (or a subject_id-bearing variant of output.schema.yaml), consistent with kickback item 2.
